```{r}
source("R/site.R")
p = published()
all_bib = paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(p)), function(i) bibtex(p[i, ]), ""), collapse = "\n\n")
```

<span class="advisee">*</span> marks a student advisee.
Also on
[Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=sRLc6F8AAAAJ&hl=en),
[ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5079-158X) and
[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/a/0000-0002-5079-158X.html).
<a download="niemi.bib" href="data:text/plain;charset=utf-8,`r utils::URLencode(all_bib, reserved = TRUE)`">Download all as BibTeX</a>.

```{r}
#| output: asis
items = vapply(seq_len(nrow(p)), function(i) pub_item(p[i, ]), "")
emit('<div class="filterable">',
     filter_controls("publications", flags = c(advisee = "With a student advisee")),
     by_year(items, p$year),
     '<p class="empty-filter" hidden>No publications match.</p>',
     '</div>')
```
